breakdown.description: `pimpleFoam` is a fluid solver and cannot compute the elastic deformation of the solid flap. A fluid-structure interaction (FSI) problem fundamentally requires two different sets of governing equations and thus two solvers (one for fluid, one for solid) that are coupled at their interface.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that `pimpleFoam` is a fluid solver and cannot be used for the solid flap. It replaced the incorrect single-solver approach with a proper partitioned fluid-structure interaction (FSI) setup, specifying `pimpleFoam` for the fluid and `solidDisplacementFoam` for the solid, along with a two-way coupling mechanism. This directly aligns with the correction made in the ground truth.
